verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence explicitly documents a free tier or trial. The pricing-page items (unlimited search, unlimited chat with papers) are not tied to any free plan. The export docs mention 'Pro, Scale, and Enterprise' and say report export works 'regardless of which Elicit plan', which implies a lower tier exists but never says it is free or what a trial user can do. Inferring a free tier from that would rest on implication rather than documented capability.
